papers.title_en: inr2action: Encoding Robot Episodes as Neural Implicit Representations for Recall and Action
papers.authors: Leann Alhashishi, Christos Margadji, Sebastian William Pattinson
papers.evidence: 面向长时程片段且支持问答的固定大小参数空间记忆
papers.tldr: 长程机器人操作需要随关键信息而非执行时长扩展的记忆。INR2Action将每段视频情节拟合为神经隐式表示，以共享元学习初始化得到的权重增量作为固定大小记忆，并经投影器映射为token嵌入，驱动语言模型问答与联合指令回归。权重增量不随帧数变化，替换为噪声或随机初始化会显著失效，证明元学习初始化对嵌入情节内容关键。该方法解耦记忆成本与时间跨度，为可扩展流式记忆提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robotic operation requires memory that scales with essential information rather than execution time. We present a parameter-space memory framework where each episode is stored as a separable object. A neural implicit representation is fitted to episode video from a shared, meta-learned initialization; the resulting weight delta constitutes the memory. Crucially, this delta remains a fixed size regardless of whether the episode spans a hundred or a hundred thousand frames. A learned projector maps the weight delta into token embeddings, conditioning a language model for question answering and a decoder for joint command regression, without frame retrieval at query time. On RoboMME, the language model exceeds chance across all question types, and the decoder achieves a mean $R^2$ of 0.51. Replacing the delta with matched noise drops performance by 11.4 points, while random-origin weights are non-decodable, proving the meta-learned initialization is essential for embedding episode content. By representing individual experiences as fixed-size weight deltas in a common parameter space, this approach decouples memory cost from time horizon and provides a basis for scalable streaming memory.

papers.title_en: Plan First, Act Later: Streaming Reasoning for Executable Memory in Robot Control
papers.authors: Qinghang Liu, Conglin Wang, Zongsheng Li, Boyong He, Han Gao, Pengcheng Wang, Tao Sun, Lige Liu, Chang Liu
papers.evidence: 含短期视觉缓冲、语义事件记忆与子任务列表的分层流式记忆
papers.tldr: 长时程机器人操作需超越短观察窗口的记忆，现有方法在执行时检索推理历史，加重高层模型负担。PAL用分层记忆框架维护短期视觉缓冲、语义事件记忆和可执行subtask_list，由高层VLM生成子任务列表，执行时选当前子任务交给低层VLA。它采用两阶段数据生成训练记忆写入与更新。RoboMME成功率达56.05%超基线44.51%，真实四任务总体60.83%优于MemER等，表明主动写入未来子任务可提升长时程控制。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon robot manipulation requires a robot to remember task-relevant information beyond its short observation window. Existing memory-augmented policies typically retrieve relevant information from history and reason over it at execution time, placing a heavy reasoning burden on the high-level model. To address this challenge, we propose PAL (\textbf{P}lan first, \textbf{A}ct \textbf{L}ater), a hierarchical memory framework for vision-language robot manipulation. It maintains a short-term visual buffer, a semantic-event memory, and an executable \texttt{subtask\_list}. A high-level vision-language model (VLM) converts streaming visual observations into the \texttt{subtask\_list}. At execution time, the VLM selects the currently relevant subtask from the \texttt{subtask\_list} and passes it to a low-level vision-language-action (VLA) policy. To teach the model what to write to memory and when to update it, we introduce a two-stage data generation procedure that first expands sparse update supervision and then uses self-labeling with task-grounded verification to generate training data that better match the state distribution encountered during execution. We evaluate our approach on memory-dependent benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks. On RoboMME, PAL achieves a \textbf{56.05\%} success rate, outperforming the strongest baseline, FrameSamp-Modul, at 44.51\%. In real-world experiments across four manipulation tasks, \pal{} reaches \textbf{60.83\%} overall success, surpassing MemER (45.00\%) and FrameSamp-Modul (28.33\%). These results show that proactively writing future-relevant subtasks into hierarchical memory improves long-horizon visual reasoning and robot control. Code and videos can be found on our website: https://qinghangliu.github.io/pal-webpage/

papers.title_en: Attn-Forcing: Learning Full-Context Attention Proxies for Streaming Video Generation
papers.authors: Junyao Gao, Sibo Liu, Jiaxing Li, Yanan Sun, Hanxin Zhu, Weidong Zhang, Jun Zhang, Cairong Zhao
papers.evidence: 流式视频生成中的有界记忆注意力代理
papers.tldr: 流式视频生成中，扩大注意力上下文能提升质量，但显存和计算开销会随上下文增长而剧增；现有注意力选择或压缩方法受限于有界表示，也缺乏注意力级监督。为此，作者提出 Attn-Forcing 框架，用可学习视觉潜变量作为注意力代理，持续逼近历史上下文引发的注意力响应，并通过代理更新模块和注意力匹配损失保留全上下文贡献。实验表明，该方法在有限显存和计算下能稳定提升生成质量，并优于现有基线，达到最优性能。
papers.abstract_en: Increasing the attention context length significantly improves streaming video generation quality, while incurring prohibitive memory and computational costs as the context grows. Existing methods attempt to capture this contextual information through attention selection or compression, but remain limited by bounded representations and lack explicit attention-level supervision to retain historical contributions to current queries. To address this, we introduce Attn-Forcing, a novel framework that preserves full-context attention contributions for streaming video generation under bounded memory and computation. We achieve this by introducing attention proxies that continuously approximate the attention responses induced by the historical context. Specifically, we implement the proxies as learnable visual latents and employ a Proxy Update Module to incorporate visual context from historical latents. Moreover, we propose an Attention Matching Loss to explicitly constrain the attention behavior of the learned proxies using full-context attention supervision. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that Attn-Forcing consistently improves streaming video generation quality and achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing baseline methods.

papers.title_en: Do 3D Large Language Models Really Use 3D Evidence?
papers.authors: Yifei Zhao, Fanyu Zhao, Han Zhang, Yixuan Lin, Yuyang Hou, Bin Wu, Ruike Cao, Li Xiao, Yinsheng Li
papers.evidence: 检验三维大模型答案是否真正基于三维证据的基准
papers.tldr: 现有3D大语言模型在场景问答中表现亮眼，但其回答是否真正依赖3D证据仍缺乏检验。作者提出UNICORNS基准，覆盖四种证据条件与八类挑战问题，并设计HORN义务感知后训练方法。评测显示最强零样本模型在可答对照上达61.22%，挑战类别仅40.94%；HORN将挑战类别提升至75.1%、整体77.2%。该工作为证据落地的3D推理提供了系统评测与改进方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recent 3D Large Language Models (3D-LLMs) have shown strong performance on scene question answering with extensive post-training. Yet, existing benchmarks rarely evaluate how 3D-LLMs respond to referential ambiguity, insufficient scene evidence, or false presuppositions, obscuring whether their responses are grounded in 3D evidence. In this work, we introduce UNICORNS, a benchmark for evaluating the reliability of 3D-LLM responses across four evidence conditions. UNICORNS contains 11,387 questions across 557 ScanNet scans, covering eight challenge categories alongside answerable controls. A response passes only if it satisfies the required response behavior and contains no scene claim unsupported by the available evidence. Evaluation of six open-sourced 3D-LLMs reveals a pronounced performance gap: even the strongest zero-shot model achieves 61.22% accuracy on answerable controls, but only 40.94% across the eight challenge categories. To address this gap, we further propose HORN, an obligation-aware post-training method combining group-relative task rewards, leaf-conditioned obligation rewards, and supervised control replay. Extensive experiments demonstrate that HORN reaches $75.1 \pm 1.0\%$ across the challenge categories and $77.2 \pm 0.8\%$ overall, outperforming all baselines without degrading answerable-control accuracy. Our findings enable a systematic evaluation and improvement of evidence-grounded 3D reasoning for 3D-LLMs (code: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/unicorns-6B38/).

papers.title_en: ATLAS: Learning to Adapt LVLM Attention for Reasoning Video Segmentation
papers.authors: Hamidreza Dastmalchi, Ali Cheraghian, Aijun An, Abdelwahed Khamis, Lars Petersson
papers.evidence: 跨视频帧从大视觉语言模型注意力提取目标中心定位线索
papers.tldr: 推理视频目标分割需要根据自然语言定位并分割视频中的对象，但LVLM注意力图常含噪、分散且跨层跨头跨模态不一致。ATLAS将各层、各头、各模态注意力视为结构化特征，融合高分辨率帧级空间信息与低分辨率视频级时序上下文，用轻量U-Net生成粗分割热图，再经SAM2传播到全视频。在多个指代与推理视频分割基准上，ATLAS优于现有冻结骨干方法，表明学习式注意力适配能有效把原始LVLM注意力转化为目标中心定位线索。
papers.abstract_en: Reasoning Video Object Segmentation (RVOS) aims to localize and segment objects referred to by natural-language expressions throughout a video. Although large vision-language models (LVLMs) implicitly encode localization cues in their attention maps, these attentions are often noisy, diffuse, and scattered across layers, heads, and modalities, limiting their direct use for segmentation. Existing methods typically rely on handcrafted attention-selection heuristics or computationally expensive attention refinement. We propose ATLAS, an attention adaptation framework that learns to transform raw LVLM attentions into object-centric localization cues. ATLAS treats attentions from all layers, heads, and modalities as structured features, combining high-resolution frame-level attentions that capture spatial information with low-resolution video-level attentions that encode temporal context. A lightweight U-Net equipped with temporal attention and FiLM-based modulation fuses these complementary representations to generate coarse segmentation heatmaps, which are propagated across the video using SAM2. Extensive experiments on challenging referring and reasoning video segmentation benchmarks show that ATLAS outperforms existing frozen-backbone methods. Code and models are available at \url{https://hamidreza-136.github.io/atlas/}.

papers.title_en: RAHF-Net: Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion for LiDAR-Assisted RGB Semantic Segmentation
papers.authors: R. D. Lin, Pengcheng Weng, Ge Wang, Han Ding, Fei Wang
papers.evidence: 将LiDAR三维体素特征投影到图像平面并与RGB特征融合
papers.tldr: 针对LiDAR辅助RGB语义分割中二维融合常丢失三维结构、且忽视LiDAR可靠性随距离变化的问题，提出RAHF-Net。该方法用C2P模块将预训练柱状体素特征投影到图像平面，并以深度导出的软距离掩码在近场做LiDAR引导几何增强、远场做视觉上下文增强。在KITTI-360上达到65.76 mIoU，较CMX提升1.45点，并在DELIVER上验证了恶劣天气、光照退化与传感器损坏下的鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: This paper studies LiDAR-assisted RGB semantic segmentation, where LiDAR point-cloud features improve dense pixel-wise predictions in the RGB image plane rather than 3D point labels or detections. Existing 2D fusion methods often project point clouds into shallow depth/range maps and apply spatially uniform fusion, discarding rich 3D structure and ignoring the range-dependent reliability of outdoor LiDAR. We propose RAHF-Net, a Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion Network. Its Cylindrical-to-Perspective (C2P) module projects pretrained cylindrical voxel features into the image plane, preserving structured 3D semantic priors. A Range-Aware Heterogeneous Fusion (RAHF) module then uses a soft depth-derived range mask to perform LiDAR-guided geometric enhancement in reliable near-field regions and visual-context enhancement in sparse far-field regions. On KITTI-360, RAHF-Net achieves 65.76 mIoU, outperforming representative RGB-only and RGB-LiDAR baselines, including CMX by 1.45 points. Experiments on DELIVER further demonstrate improved robustness under adverse weather, illumination degradation, and sensor corruption.

papers.title_en: SAPO: Self-Supervised Attention Policy Optimization for Improving Temporal Video Grounding in Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Zixuan Chen, Depeng Wang, Wei Chen, Ke Xu, Ya Guo, Huijia Zhu, Tanfeng Sun, Xinghao Jiang
papers.evidence: 视觉语言模型内部编码时间位置但生成时间戳时失准
papers.tldr: 视频视觉语言模型语义理解强，但时间定位输出不准；作者发现模型内部注意力区间常比预测时间戳更准，称其为“时间生成差距”。为此提出 SAPO，用内部时间注意力自监督 GRPO，并用无真值准则筛选高价值样本。实验在多个数据集和模型上稳定提升时间定位，Qwen2.5-VL-3B 相对 mIoU 提升 33.7%，强模型 Time-R1-7B 也提升 5.4%。该方法仅需无标注视频-查询对，且跨数据集迁移并保持通用视频理解。
papers.abstract_en: Video vision-language models (VLMs) have strong semantic understanding, yet remain unreliable at precise temporal grounding. Existing gains from explicitly aligning video frames with absolute time suggest that VLMs may already encode accurate temporal locations internally but lose precision when expressing them as timestamps. Our analysis across four VLMs and two grounding datasets confirms this hypothesis: attention intervals outperform predicted intervals on approximately 66% of valid examples. We term this discrepancy the temporal generation gap. Because precise temporal annotations are expensive, this finding motivates closing the gap to improve temporal grounding using only unlabeled video-query pairs. We propose Self-Supervised Attention Policy Optimization (SAPO), which uses internal temporal attention as self-supervision for Group Relative Policy Optimization and applies a ground-truth-free criterion to select high-value samples. SAPO consistently improves temporal grounding across multiple datasets and models spanning weak to strong initial grounding ability. Relative mIoU gains reach 33.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 5.4% on the strong Time-R1-7B. The improvements transfer across datasets while preserving general video understanding.

papers.title_en: HiQGS: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Querying for Feed-Forward Gaussian Reconstruction
papers.authors: Qiaowei Miao, Qifeng Cheng, Yijing Guo, Yuru Xiao, Ziqian Ni, Sheng Yang
papers.evidence: 层次化查询对齐跨空间尺度、视角与时间戳的证据
papers.tldr: 稀疏单目帧的前馈高斯重建需联合处理视角与时间变化，现有方法要么将高斯绑定到单帧特征，要么用紧凑潜查询聚合而缺乏按目标时刻组织证据。HiQGS提出分层时空编码器，按图像位置、观测时间和相机位姿组织多分辨率几何外观特征，并用时间自适应解码器以目标时间戳查询层次表示。实验在静态和动态重建基准上取得较强渲染质量与几何精度。该工作提升了跨尺度、视角和时间证据的对齐与整合能力。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction from sparse posed monocular frames requires reasoning over observations that vary jointly in viewpoint and time. Existing methods either predict Gaussian primitives from observation-aligned features or aggregate multi-frame information through compact latent queries. However, the former tightly couples Gaussian allocation to individual frames, while the latter does not explicitly structure observed evidence according to its temporal relation to the requested timestamp. Consequently, evidence across spatial scales, viewpoints, and timestamps can be difficult to align and integrate. We present \textbf{HiQGS}, a query-based hierarchical framework for feed-forward Gaussian scene reconstruction from sparse monocular frames. HiQGS introduces a \textbf{Hierarchical Spatiotemporal Encoder} that organizes multi-resolution geometry-appearance visual features according to image location, observation time, and camera pose, thereby preserving complementary appearance and structural cues. Our \textbf{Time-Adaptive Decoder} use target timestamp queries the resulting hierarchical representation to retrieve relevant spatiotemporal evidence and predicts the corresponding Gaussian scene state. Experiments on static and dynamic scene reconstruction benchmarks demonstrate strong rendering quality and geometric accuracy, validating the effectiveness of hierarchical visual encoding and target-time-aware Gaussian querying.

papers.title_en: Latent Bridge: From Video Latents to 3D Geometry via Feature Alignment
papers.authors: Shuai Zhang, Zhanpeng Ouyang, Zhengqing Chen, Ruohong Mei, Shaoyu Chen, Weiqiang Ren, Hui Sun, Qian Zhang, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang
papers.evidence: 连接视频潜空间与三维几何特征
papers.tldr: 视频生成与3D重建通常依赖分离表示，需先解码RGB再重编码才能恢复几何。Latent Bridge通过特征蒸馏训练表示专用桥接器，将Wan2.1和V-RAE的视频潜空间对齐到几何特征空间，直接从视频latent前馈预测相机、深度与点云。推理时同一latent可同时解码RGB和预测几何，桥接器还能复用于图生视频与文生视频。在Co3Dv2和WildRGB-D上取得有竞争力的重建质量，并加快latent到几何解码。
papers.abstract_en: Video generation and feed-forward 3D reconstruction typically use separate representations, requiring RGB decoding and visual re-encoding to recover geometry from generated latents. We propose Latent Bridge, which connects video generative latent spaces with geometric feature spaces to directly predict 3D geometry from video latents. We develop representation-specific bridges for Wan2.1 and V-RAE, enabling feed-forward prediction of cameras, depth, and 3D point clouds without the intermediate RGB pathway. Each bridge is trained on RGB videos through feature distillation, while the video encoder and geometry model remain frozen. Training requires neither ground-truth geometry nor execution of the downstream geometric aggregator or prediction heads. At inference, the same video latents support both RGB decoding and geometry prediction. The same trained bridge can be reused for image-to-video and text-to-video generation within the same video latent space, without bridge retraining. Experiments on Co3Dv2 and WildRGB-D demonstrate competitive geometric reconstruction quality, efficient end-to-end generation and reconstruction, and faster latent-to-geometry decoding, highlighting latent alignment as a practical and reusable interface between video generation and 3D reconstruction. Our code is available at: https://github.com/hustvl/Latent-Bridge.

papers.title_en: MindView: Benchmarking Generative Multi-View Spatial Intelligence
papers.authors: Yanbo Wang, Siqi Luo, Siyu Zhang, Chenming Zhu, Wenzhao Zheng, Qian Yu, Juncheng Yan, Bin Fu, Tai Wang, Yu Qiao, Yihao Liu, Jiwen Lu
papers.evidence: 跨视角空间一致的多视图生成
papers.tldr: 针对部分多视角观测下语言引导生成空间一致视角的评测空白，作者提出MindView基准，覆盖三个室内数据集、513个场景、1500个样本与七类几何/语义任务，并系统评测11个生成器。结果显示现有模型整体表现有限，且在扩展上下文下分数普遍下降。微调BAGEL后总分提升24.3分且七项任务全涨，并迁移到三个空间理解基准。MindCue以目标视角假设选择证据，扭转扩展上下文退化并超过标准上下文基线，为生成式多视角空间智能提供测试平台。
papers.abstract_en: Spatial intelligence has recently been assessed through generative tasks such as spatially grounded image editing, yet language-guided generation of spatially consistent views from partial multi-view observations remains underexplored. We introduce MindView, a benchmark for generative multi-view spatial intelligence with 1,500 samples from 513 scenes across three indoor datasets. Its seven tasks form two families: geometry-dominant tasks specify changes in camera position and orientation, while semantics-dominant tasks require inferring target viewpoints by grounding referred objects and interpreting spatial relations and reference-frame cues. Evaluation of eleven generators reveals substantial room for improvement on MindView. A paired context analysis further shows that all eleven generators obtain lower overall scores under the expanded context setting. These findings motivate us to investigate whether task-specific supervision can improve target-view generation and whether models can use additional multi-view evidence effectively. We therefore fine-tune BAGEL on the MindView training dataset, improving its overall score by 24.3 points and yielding gains across all seven MindView tasks. Beyond these generation gains, the fine-tuned model also yields higher scores on three spatial-understanding benchmarks without training on their annotations, suggesting that learning to generate spatially grounded views may benefit spatial understanding. To improve evidence utilization under expanded context, we propose MindCue, a training-free spatial evidence selector guided by a target-view hypothesis. MindCue reverses the drop in overall score under expanded context and outperforms the standard-context baseline. Overall, MindView provides a concrete testbed for generative multi-view spatial intelligence.

papers.title_en: R4DGS: Referring Segmentation in 4D Gaussian Splatting
papers.authors: Bangpu Chen, Yaxuan Li, Shirui Peng, Xiangtian Si, Liuxin Chu, Xitong Cao, Hongbo Jin, Jiayu Ding
papers.evidence: 在动态四维场景中对时序变化目标进行语言指代分割
papers.tldr: 现有4D高斯泼溅多面向重建与渲染，难以支持动态场景中的自然语言指代分割。本文提出R4DGS任务并构建R4D-Bench-QA基准，涵盖时序变化、多目标、推理密集及零目标/干扰表达。方法ReferGaussian将动态高斯组织为EntityBank中的语言可寻址实体，借助MLLM分解查询并执行约束感知的免训练定位。实验在R4D-Bench-QA与4D LangSplat协议上提升时序目标选择，并取得有竞争力的时空定位效果。
papers.abstract_en: Dynamic representations based on 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS) have shown strong capabilities in reconstruction and rendering, yet current methods remain limited in supporting complex natural-language referring in dynamic scenes. Existing 4D Gaussian methods are primarily designed for rendering-oriented dynamic modeling, while current semantic extensions often rely on scene-specific semantic optimization or are evaluated on relatively simple query settings. In this paper, we study Referring 4D Gaussian Splatting (R4DGS), a task for grounding temporally varying, multi-target or reasoning-intensive, and zero-target or distractor expressions in dynamic 4D scenes. To support this task, we introduce R4D-Bench-QA, a benchmark with structured query annotations. We further present ReferGaussian, a unified framework built upon 4DGS that converts low-level dynamic Gaussians into persistent, language-addressable entities for training-free referring inference. ReferGaussian organizes mask-supported Gaussian entities in an EntityBank, uses Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to decompose complex queries into trackable object phrases and structured referring constraints, and performs constraint-aware grounding without scene-specific semantic optimization. Experiments on R4D-Bench-QA and the 4D LangSplat protocol demonstrate improved temporal target selection and competitive spatiotemporal grounding without scene-specific semantic training. Project resources are available at https://chenbangpu.github.io/R4DGS/.

papers.title_en: RaSFNet: Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network for LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
papers.evidence: 用于LiDAR分割的射线对齐扫描感知2D-3D特征融合
papers.tldr: 针对LiDAR点云投影分割中frustum内几何被模糊、跨扫描区域关系难建模及点-投影特征错配问题，RaSFNet将射线对齐几何编码与扫描拓扑先验引入融合框架。RAGDE刻画frustum内点分布，STAM按方位采样模式建模长程依赖，RCPFF以距离约束引导点与frustum特征交换。在SemanticKITTI和nuScenes验证集上分别取得70.2%和77.7% mIoU。该工作提升了投影式分割的几何与扫描感知能力，为LiDAR语义分割提供有效融合方案。
papers.abstract_en: LiDAR point cloud semantic segmentation is a fundamental component of 3D perception for autonomous driving and robotics. Projection-based methods map 3D point clouds into 2D representations for feature extraction using 2D networks. However, aggregating multiple points during projection can obscure geometric differences within each frustum, while local feature extraction limits the modeling of spatial relationships across scanning regions. Moreover, proximity in the projected representation does not necessarily imply proximity in 3D space, and interactions between point and projected features may mix features from different ranges, reducing semantic discriminability. To address these challenges, we propose the Ray-aligned and Scan-aware Fusion Network (RaSFNet), which incorporates point cloud geometry and LiDAR scanning characteristics into projection-based semantic segmentation. Specifically, the Ray-Aligned Geometric Distribution Encoding (RAGDE) module characterizes point distributions within each frustum using a ray-aligned coordinate system. To model spatial context, a Scan-Topology-Aware Mamba (STAM) block organizes frustum features according to the LiDAR azimuth sampling pattern and captures long-range dependencies across scanning regions. In addition, a Range-Constrained Point-Frustum Fusion (RCPFF) mechanism uses shared range information to guide feature exchange between point and frustum representations while maintaining spatial correspondence. RaSFNet achieves mIoU scores of 70.2% and 77.7% on the SemanticKITTI and nuScenes validation sets, respectively, indicating competitive segmentation performance compared with the evaluated methods.
